## 10. Retention of Accommodation  
Concessional period of retention.(1) The allottee may, subject to the conditions laid down in these rules, be permitted to retain the accommodation on the happening of any of the events specified in Column (2) of the table below, for the period specified in the corresponding entry in Column (3) thereof, provided that the accommodation is required for the bona fide use of the allottee or members of his family:-
